name: whatsapp
title: WhatsApp
description: A WhatsApp business number on Meta's Cloud API — people message it, an agent answers. Messages arrive by webhook, so Meta must be able to reach this instance.

phone_number_id.label: Phone number ID
phone_number_id.hint: From the Meta app's WhatsApp setup page — the ID, not the number itself. The free test number works and needs no business verification.

verify_token.label: Webhook verify token
verify_token.hint: Any string you choose. Paste the same one into Meta's webhook configuration — it is what proves the callback URL is yours.
